halfmasa.config.creative.comment.giveFul:
In creative mode, press G to create a full container using these rules:
- Main-hand regular item, empty offhand: shulker box filled with the item
- Main-hand regular item, container offhand: offhand container filled with the item
- Main-hand regular item, bundle offhand: insert items according to the bundle fill count
- Empty shulker box in main hand, empty offhand: chest filled with stacked shulker boxes
- Empty shulker box in main hand, container offhand: offhand container filled with stacked shulker boxes
- Filled shulker box in main hand, empty offhand: chest filled with full shulker boxes
- Filled shulker box in main hand, container offhand: offhand container filled with full shulker boxes
- Container nesting safety blocks unsafe nesting when enabled; inspired by TechUtils (The Unlicense); source https://github.com/VelizarBG/techutils
halfmasa.config.creative.comment.bundleF: Number of stack insertion attempts when the offhand target is a bundle
halfmasa.config.creative.comment.fillSaf: Prevents unsafe nested containers and shulker boxes
halfmasa.config.creative.comment.itemSea: Records items obtained after creative searches and displays an independent history area above creative search results; storage and UI are independently implemented by halfmasa; disabled by default
Maximum rows shown by the creative search history area from 1 to 9; defaults to 3
Keeps history above results while search text is present; when disabled, obtained items are still recorded and history returns after clearing the search field; disabled by default

Rows shown by the REI and JEI history grids from 1 to 9; defaults to 3
Anchors history to a corner of the entire game screen while the native item list makes room; defaults to bottom-right
halfmasa.config.ported.comment.cycleItem: Cycles the history panel through bottom-right, top-right, top-left, and bottom-left; unbound by default

Replaces vanilla's expiring Night Vision flicker with a configurable smooth fade; disable to restore vanilla behavior; enabled by default
halfmasa.config.ported.comment.centerPla: Removes the vanilla random horizontal offset from flower and plant models so they stay centered in their blocks; expand to control each plant separately; the master toggle is disabled by default and supports a keybind
Shows an individual centering toggle for each flower and plant
Whether to remove this flower or plant model's random horizontal offset; enabled by default and supports a keybind
halfmasa.config.ported.comment.nightVisi: Controls whether the Night Vision fade duration setting is shown
halfmasa.config.ported.comment.boatView3: Removes the local player's +/-105-degree boat view limit; inspired by BoatView360 (LGPL-3.0); source https://github.com/AsOne2020/BoatView360; disabled by default
halfmasa.config.ported.comment.boatItemV: Keeps first-person held items visible while rowing makes the player's hands busy; inspired by Boat Item View (LGPL-3.0); source https://github.com/50ap5ud5/BoatItemView; disabled by default
halfmasa.config.ported.comment.voidTradi: When enabled, opening a trade screen for a villager in a boat or minecart takes fake players offline; closing the screen restores them using the selected recovery mode; disabled by default and can be bound to a custom hotkey
Controls whether detailed Void Trading settings are shown; can be bound to a custom hotkey
Enter exact names separated by commas; automatic detection also tries to identify other players aboard the same vehicle
Treats other players aboard the same vehicle as fake players and sends them the offline command; enable only when no real player is aboard; can be bound to a custom hotkey
Defaults to rejoin; spawn mode waits until the fake player appears online before sending mount

The local player automatically buys selected offers in the open villager screen after the villager disappears or all configured fake players go offline; each offer is bought until materials run out, so keep the screen open; can be bound to a custom hotkey

When enabled, automatically try to open a villager's trade screen while targeting it, retrying once per second when no screen is open; press the cancel hotkey to stop auto-open; bind a hotkey to enable
Closes the current villager trade screen and stops auto-open; defaults to Esc and can be rebound
Indices start at 1; separate them with commas, such as 1,2,3. These offer rows are processed in order until materials run out when item filtering is disabled
Scan all offer rows and buy only offers whose output matches the whitelist; add at least one item ID; can be bound to a custom hotkey
Enter one item ID per row, such as minecraft:emerald or modid:item_name; multiple entries are supported; used when the specified-item toggle is enabled
Closes the villager trade screen after all configured offers have been processed; disabled by default and can be bound to a custom hotkey
Drops items obtained by this automatic trade run after all configured offers finish; disabled by default and can be bound to a custom hotkey

Before auto-trading, convert emerald blocks in your inventory and QuickShulker boxes into emeralds; Fabric API is required on both client and server, and the server needs the Void Trading support mod; disabled by default and can be bound to a custom hotkey

Before trading, use the QuickShulker API to retrieve emeralds and emerald blocks from boxes in your inventory; Fabric API is required on both client and server, and the server also needs the Void Trading support mod and QuickShulker; disabled by default and can be bound to a custom hotkey

Applies Chinese-English spacing to translated menus, item names, and mod configuration text while keeping width measurement and wrapping accurate; enabled by default
Adds Chinese-English display spacing when signs are rendered without changing their stored text; enabled by default
Adds Chinese-English display spacing in Book and Quill editing and written-book reading while keeping cursor, selection, and click positions mapped to the original text; enabled by default

halfmasa.config.ported.comment.mapInSlot: Renders filled map contents inside hotbar and inventory slots while retaining count and decoration layers; inspired by Map In Slot (MIT); source https://github.com/Crec0/map-in-slot; disabled by default
